Weapon slots

Switch weapons using your equipped weapon slots.

Assign weapons in the equipment screen before using their quick slots in the field.

Controls depend on your keyboard, gamepad and camera settings. The in-game guide shows your current bindings.

Classic edition reference

These original pages describe classic mouse and keyboard controls. Use the guidance above for current settings and gamepad controls.

Choosing weapons

Your character may use up to 4 different weapons while in the Game zone. To ready a weapon, click on its picture (its easy to see - the weapons are framed).

You can also choose weapons via the following keyboard keys:
Use weapon 1: <Q> key.
Use weapon 2: <W> key.
Use weapon 3: <E> key.
Use weapon 4: <R> key.
